waited_and_retried.evidence: Two attempts after a reload and 7 s settle: 33 rows first, 71 after scrolling, both times; no 'Rows per page' or 'n-m of N' text.

precondition_read_back.evidence: More than 33 work orders exist at the location (71 loaded after scrolling).

searched_the_repo.evidence: git grep 'rows per page' / 'Rows per page' under build/wo-board-tech-view: none observed; regression helper saw the same (notes on C368197).
